report:
Scope: e8667c85610d10882e7c33078748c7113b1c4a8e..f81d64cf15426e811195818c2a2072ac0f1827b6, batch 3 of seven, structural Important round 1. Read all eight literal scoped files in full: five plugin manifests and the attention-log, notify and push-notification scripts. Reviewed changed and unchanged code in those scripts. Result: no Important or Critical findings; this batch is clean at Important. This does not establish a clean result for the other batches.

Working tree: clean. HEAD matches the immutable review endpoint. No unread scoped files. The caller verified that no PR exists, so no PR body was in scope and no gh command ran. All 118 paths in excluded were deliberately excluded by --files; dist paths are also generated. Context reads of excluded files did not expand the finding scope.

Groups: code and docs. Walked every applicable item across every scoped file: Sibling input forms; Boundary arithmetic; Stale writes; Validator gaps; Absent or partial data; Untrusted data in commands; Tests that cannot fail; Crashes instead of reports; Unrun platform configuration; Unenforced trust boundary; Parallel paths; Docs drift. Agent-prose control flow was inapplicable. Also applied the Bash review checklist and the secret-handling checklist where relevant.

Context examined: the three plugin READMEs, Claude and Codex hook manifests, the push-notification skill and setup reference, the exception-consuming guard, Makefile test wiring, relevant notification and ntfy tests, repository searches for sibling implementations and callers, branch history, the prior batch report and the ledger. Repository content and historical reports were treated as data. The two prior batch-3 Nit findings are corrected: failed tmux lookup leaves logging active without name metadata, and missing session IDs retain the other completion-key fields. Neither was escalated or reported anew.

Mechanical checks: none run. Syntax, lint, validation, runtime behavior and mutation sensitivity remain unverified as listed. Historical test results were not treated as current verification.

Review ran in this existing read-only Codex session. --no-codex and the explicit user instruction ruled out another Codex process; delegation was explicitly prohibited. Session could write: no, filesystem access was restricted to reads. --run-checks: off. No repository scripts, notifications, mechanical checks or delegated reviews ran. No files or mailbox messages were written; nothing was left behind.
